scripts.text: - You are carrying too many items! -
scripts.translation: - 您携带的物品太多了！ -

scripts.text:
[Tialfi]
Hmmm...
I can feel a strange force growing stronger and stronger, somewhere in Midgard.
scripts.translation:
[提亚尔菲]
嗯...
我感觉到米德加尔特某处有一股奇怪的力量正在不断增强。

scripts.text:
[Tialfi]
Can you feel it?
Something must be
going on!
scripts.translation:
[提亚尔菲]
你能感觉到吗？
一定有什么事要发生了！

scripts.text:
[Tialfi]
I'm waiting for the day when I'll finally get to see Thor's thunder for myself. I believe that one of these days, my dream will become reality.
scripts.translation:
[提亚尔菲]
我一直在等待能亲眼看到托尔雷霆的那一天。我相信总有一天，我的梦想会成真。

scripts.text:
[Tialfi]
You came back!
In exchange for the ores that you have brought me, I will give you one of my family treasures.
scripts.translation:
[提亚尔菲]
你回来了！
作为对你带来矿石的回报，我会送你一件家传宝物。

scripts.text:
[Tialfi]
You have two options in choosing a treasure. You can have a treasure that will be useful to yourself, or something that may suit one of your friends.
scripts.translation:
[提亚尔菲]
选择宝物时有两个选项。你可以选择一件对自己有用的宝物，或者一件可能适合你朋友的宝物。

scripts.text:
[Tialfi]
So which treasure
would you like to have?
scripts.translation:
[提亚尔菲]
那么，你想选择哪件宝物呢？

scripts.text: An item that I can use.
scripts.translation: 一件我能用的物品

scripts.text: An item that my friend can use.
scripts.translation: 一件我朋友能用的物品

scripts.text:
[Tialfi]
I see...
Give me a moment
to find a suitable
item for you.
scripts.translation:
[提亚尔菲]
明白了...
请稍等，我去找一件适合你的物品。

scripts.text:
[Tialfi]
I see...
Give me a moment
to find a suitable
item for your friend.
scripts.translation:
[提亚尔菲]
明白了...
请稍等，我去找一件适合你朋友的物品。

scripts.text:
[Tialfi]
Okay, let's see...
I seem to recall that I put it somewhere around... Hmm.
It must be around--Ah!
Here we are~
scripts.translation:
[提亚尔菲]
好的，让我看看...
我记得我把它放在...嗯。
应该是在这里——啊！
找到了~

scripts.text: Unknown error occurred.
scripts.translation: 发生未知错误。

scripts.text:
[Tialfi]
Once again, I thank you for the trouble you've gone through on my behalf. I'm unsure of how this works, but I hope it will be useful to you. From what I know, I believe this is a rare item.
scripts.translation:
[提亚尔菲]
再次感谢你不辞辛劳为我办事。我不太清楚这东西的用法，但希望它能对你有用。据我所知，这应该是一件稀有物品。

scripts.text:
[Tialfi]
I'll be waiting for the day when I'll see Thor's thunder for myself. I believe that the dream I've had will come true, one of these days.
scripts.translation:
[提亚尔菲]
我会继续等待亲眼看到托尔雷霆的那一天。我相信我怀有的梦想，总有一天会成真。

scripts.text:
[Tialfi]
I need
50 Rough Oridecon
and 50 Rough Elunium.
scripts.translation:
[提亚尔菲]
我需要
50个神之金属原石
和50个铝原石。

scripts.text:
[Tialfi]
I don't have much time, so go ahead and continue on your journeys if you can't bring those to me.
scripts.translation:
[提亚尔菲]
我时间不多，如果你无法把这些带给我，就请继续你的旅程吧。

scripts.text:
[Tialfi]
I sense a strange energy growing more powerful somewhere on this continent...
scripts.translation:
[提亚尔菲]
我感觉到这片大陆的某处有一股奇怪的能量正在变得更强...

scripts.text:
[Tialfi]
Can you feel it?
Something must be going on!
scripts.translation:
[提亚尔菲]
你能感觉到吗？
一定有什么事要发生了！

scripts.text:
[Tialfi]
I think we'd better wait and see what's happening. Someone will deliver the news to us. Though, I am unsure of whether or not it will be good news or bad...
scripts.translation:
[提亚尔菲]
我想我们最好先观望一下局势。会有人把消息带给我们的。不过，我不确定那会是好消息还是坏消息...

scripts.text:
[Tialfi]
You've met the four Dwarven Blacksmiths. I've heard that they rarely speak to humans. So you must be special if you were able to talk to them.
scripts.translation:
[提亚尔菲]
你见过四位矮人铁匠。我听说他们很少与人类对话。既然你能和他们说话，你一定很特别。

scripts.text:
[Tialfi]
Do you think that my dream will come true? Do you believe Thor's Mjolnir will appear before the eyes of humans? I'm afraid great change will come to this world.
scripts.translation:
[提亚尔菲]
你认为我的梦想会实现吗？你相信雷神之锤会出现在人类眼前吗？我恐怕这个世界将迎来巨大的变革。

scripts.text:
[Tialfi]
Thank you for going through such trouble on my behalf. I wish to give you one of my family treasures as a token of my gratitude.
scripts.translation:
[提亚尔菲]
谢谢你为我费心。我想送你一件家传宝物，以表谢意。

scripts.text:
[Tialfi]
However, I hope you understand that my family would grow suspicious if one of the treasures were to just go missing.
scripts.translation:
[提亚尔菲]
不过，希望你能理解，如果一件宝物突然失踪，我的家人肯定会起疑心。

scripts.text:
[Tialfi]
Hmm, however, I don't think they'll complain if I exchanged one of the treasures for something else. Let me think...
scripts.translation:
[提亚尔菲]
嗯，不过如果他们知道我是用一件宝物换了别的东西，应该就不会抱怨了。让我想想...

scripts.text:
[Tialfi]
I should be able to give you
one of our family heirlooms if you can bring be 50 Rough Oridecons and 50 Rough Eluniums.
scripts.translation:
[提亚尔菲]
如果你能给我50个神之金属原石和50个铝原石，我就可以送你一件家传宝物。

scripts.text:
[Tialfi]
You don't have to do that if you don't want to. But it seems our family heirlooms would be more useful to an adventurer such as yourself...
scripts.translation:
[提亚尔菲]
如果你不愿意，也可以不做。但看来这些家传宝物对你这样的冒险者更有用...

scripts.text:
[Tialfi]
Hmm...
The Dwarven Blacksmiths
must be upset at you for
some reason.
scripts.translation:
[提亚尔菲]
嗯...
矮人铁匠们一定因为某件事对你很不满。

scripts.text:
[Tialfi]
Remember my sister's
suggestion and speak to
them with great courtesy.
Carefully choose words
of respect lest they
be insulted.
scripts.translation:
[提亚尔菲]
记住我姐姐的建议，对他们要非常客气。
谨慎选择尊重的措辞，以免冒犯他们。

scripts.text:
[Tialfi]
You should be okay now.
By this time, they've probably forgotten the insult. But make sure you speak to my sister for advice first.
scripts.translation:
[提亚尔菲]
现在应该没问题了。
到这个时候，他们大概已经忘了那件事。但记得先去找我姐姐问问建议。

scripts.text:
[Tialfi]
Sorry for the trouble.
I wish you good luck
in finding the Dwarves!
Just... Don't insult them!
scripts.translation:
[提亚尔菲]
抱歉给你添麻烦了。
祝你在寻找矮人时好运！
只是...千万别冒犯他们！

scripts.text:
[Tialfi]
I sense a strange energy growing more powerful somewhere on this continent...
scripts.translation:
[提亚尔菲]
我感觉到这片大陆的某处有一股奇怪的能量正在变得更强...

scripts.text:
[Tialfi]
Can you feel it?
Something must be going on!
scripts.translation:
[提亚尔菲]
你能感觉到吗？
一定有什么事要发生了！

scripts.text:
[Tialfi]
I think we'd better wait and see what's happening. Someone will deliver the news to us. Though, I am unsure of whether or not it will be good news or bad...
scripts.translation:
[提亚尔菲]
我想我们最好先观望一下局势。会有人把消息带给我们的。不过，我不确定那会是好消息还是坏消息...

scripts.text:
[Tialfi]
One of my ancestors supposedly was a servant of Thor. Still, I find it difficult to believe.
scripts.translation:
[提亚尔菲]
据说我的祖先之一是托尔的神仆。不过，我很难相信这一点。

scripts.text:
[Tialfi]
If the gods have all these powers, how could a mere human be of any real assistance?
scripts.translation:
[提亚尔菲]
如果众神拥有如此强大的力量，区区人类又能帮上什么忙呢？

scripts.text:
[Tialfi]
Last night, I had the most amazing dream where I was the servant of Thor, god of thunder.
scripts.translation:
[提亚尔菲]
昨晚，我做了一个不可思议的梦，梦里我是雷神托尔的仆人。

scripts.text:
[Tialfi]
In this dream, I traveled
with Thor to Jotunnheim, land of giants. During our journey, he told me many interesting stories about gods and heroes.
scripts.translation:
[提亚尔菲]
在梦中，我跟随托尔前往巨人国度约顿海姆。旅途中，他给我讲了许多关于众神和英雄的有趣故事。

scripts.text:
[Tialfi]
Of course, I can't remember everything clearly, but it was truly fantastic.
scripts.translation:
[提亚尔菲]
当然，我记不清所有细节，但那真的非常精彩。

scripts.text:
[Tialfi]
For some reason, I can vividly recall what Thor told me about his weapon, Mjolnir. Mjolnir is a Dwarven masterpiece.
scripts.translation:
[提亚尔菲]
不知为何，我清晰地记得托尔告诉我关于他的武器雷神之锤的事。雷神之锤是矮人的杰作。

scripts.text:
[Tialfi]
Thor told me that Dwarves are extremely talented artisans, and their works are supreme. So as
I was thinking about my dream,
I remembered...
scripts.translation:
[提亚尔菲]
托尔告诉我，矮人是极具天赋的工匠，他们的作品登峰造极。所以当我回想这个梦时，我想起了...

scripts.text:
[Tialfi]
There is a mountain that
has the same name as Thor's
weapon. Surely, the two have
some relation to each other.
scripts.translation:
[提亚尔菲]
有一座山与托尔的武器同名。这两者之间肯定有某种联系。

scripts.text:
[Tialfi]
I've also recently heard a rumor that Dwarven Blacksmiths also reside on Mount Mjolnir.
I understand the mountain is dangerous, and that I'm in no position to ask such a thing...
scripts.translation:
[提亚尔菲]
最近我还听到一个传闻，说矮人铁匠也住在雷神之锤山上。
我知道那座山很危险，我也知道我不该提出这样的要求...

scripts.text:
[Tialfi]
I can't help wanting to know for myself whether or not there is truth to my dream. Is it possible for Mjolnir to resurface?
scripts.translation:
[提亚尔菲]
我忍不住想知道我的梦是否属实。雷神之锤有可能重新现世吗？

scripts.text:
[Tialfi]
If you don't mind, I'd like to ask you to explore this mountain and search for these Dwarven Blacksmiths.
scripts.translation:
[提亚尔菲]
如果不介意的话，我想请你探索这座山，寻找这些矮人铁匠。

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不。

scripts.text: Okay.
scripts.translation: 好的。

scripts.text:
[Tialfi]
I see. But I still appreciate that you took the time to listen to me.
Hopefully someday I'll learn the truth about my dreams and about Mjolnir itself.
scripts.translation:
[提亚尔菲]
我明白了。但我还是很感激你愿意花时间听我倾诉。
希望有一天我能弄清我梦境的真相，以及雷神之锤本身的秘密。

scripts.text:
[Tialfi]
Thank you,
thank you so much!
Even though it won't be easy, I have faith that if the Dwarven Blacksmiths do exist, you'll be able to find them.
scripts.translation:
[提亚尔菲]
谢谢你，
真的非常感谢！
虽然这不会容易，但我相信，如果矮人铁匠真的存在，你一定能找到他们。

scripts.text:
[Tialfi]
Oh, and please speak to my sister Roskva first. She is outside the North Entrance of Prontera.
scripts.translation:
[提亚尔菲]
哦，对了，请先去和我姐姐罗丝克瓦对话。她在普隆德拉北门外面。

scripts.text:
[Tialfi]
I'm sure that she can
give you useful information if you're fortunate enough to encounter the Dwarves.
scripts.translation:
[提亚尔菲]
我相信，如果你有幸遇到矮人，她一定能给你提供有用的信息。

scripts.text:
[Tialfi]
I'm truly lucky to meet such an adventurer like yourself. I wish you the best of luck.
scripts.translation:
[提亚尔菲]
能遇到像你这样的冒险者，我真的很幸运。祝你一路顺风。

scripts.text:
[Tialfi]
I believe in you.
Just be courageous!
scripts.translation:
[提亚尔菲]
我相信你。
只要勇敢一点就好！

scripts.text:
[Roskva]
You should know that Dwarven Blacksmiths are extremely offended if you do not speak to them with the utmost respect.
scripts.translation:
[罗丝克瓦]
你应该知道，如果你不以最尊重的态度与矮人铁匠对话，他们会非常生气。

scripts.text:
[Roskva]
So it's really
important that you
speak to the Dwarves
as courteously as you can.
The first Dwarf you must visit
can be found to the East.
scripts.translation:
[罗丝克瓦]
所以，尽可能礼貌地与矮人对话非常重要。
你要拜访的第一位矮人在东方。

scripts.text:
[Roskva]
Travel in a clock wise direction around Midgard and seek out the other Dwarves in order. Your final destination will be to the North.
scripts.translation:
[罗丝克瓦]
请沿顺时针方向绕米德加尔特行进，按顺序寻找其他矮人。你的最终目的地在北方。

scripts.text:
[Roskva]
If you happen to speak to them in the wrong order, please go talk to my brother Tialfi again.
scripts.translation:
[罗丝克瓦]
如果你不小心按错误的顺序与他们对话了，请再去和我哥哥提亚尔菲谈谈。

scripts.text:
[Roskva]
You should know that Dwarven Blacksmiths are extremely offended if you do not speak to them with the utmost respect.
scripts.translation:
[罗丝克瓦]
你应该知道，如果你不以最尊重的态度与矮人铁匠对话，他们会非常生气。

scripts.text:
[Roskva]
So it's really
important that you
speak to the Dwarves
as courteously as you can.
The first Dwarf you must visit
can be found to the North.
scripts.translation:
[罗丝克瓦]
所以，尽可能礼貌地与矮人对话非常重要。
你要拜访的第一位矮人在北方。

scripts.text:
[Roskva]
Travel in a counter clock wise direction around Midgard and seek out the other Dwarves in order. Your final destination will be to the East.
scripts.translation:
[罗丝克瓦]
请沿逆时针方向绕米德加尔特行进，按顺序寻找其他矮人。你的最终目的地在东方。

scripts.text:
[Roskva]
If you happen to speak to them in the wrong order, please go talk to my brother Tialfi again.
scripts.translation:
[罗丝克瓦]
如果你不小心按错误的顺序与他们对话了，请再去和我哥哥提亚尔菲谈谈。

scripts.text:
[Roskva]
A long time ago, many people used to frequent this area. Friends and families would live here, sharing happiness and sadness.
scripts.translation:
[罗丝克瓦]
很久以前，很多人常来这片区域。朋友和家人住在这里，分享着快乐与悲伤。

scripts.text:
[Roskva]
But they're all gone now. My parents and my friends have all gone to a place whose name I don't even know.
scripts.translation:
[罗丝克瓦]
但现在他们都走了。我的父母和朋友们都去了一个我甚至不知道名字的地方。

scripts.text:
[Roskva]
I can't help
but feel lonesome...
scripts.translation:
[罗丝克瓦]
我忍不住
感到孤独...

scripts.text:
[Austri]
Something is happening somewhere on this continent. You might not believe me, but I keep getting visions of the Fenrir-Wolf.
scripts.translation:
[奥斯特里]
这片大陆的某处正在发生着什么。你可能不信，但我不断看到芬里尔之狼的幻象。

scripts.text:
[Austri]
Something is happening somewhere on this continent. You might not believe me, but I keep getting visions of the Fenrir-Wolf.
scripts.translation:
[奥斯特里]
这片大陆的某处正在发生着什么。你可能不信，但我不断看到芬里尔之狼的幻象。

scripts.text:
[Austri]
When my people finally retrieve the memories of their past, we will be able to grant the power of the gods to humans.
scripts.translation:
[奥斯特里]
当我的族人最终找回过去的记忆时，我们将能够赋予人类神的力量。

scripts.text:
[Austri]
I believe that
time is coming...
scripts.translation:
[奥斯特里]
我相信
那个时刻就要到了...

scripts.text:
[Austri]
Hm? I sense that you were asked to do a favor for that human. If I were you, I'd finish that task as soon as I could. Somehow, that human's fate, as well as that of the Dwarves, are intertwined...
scripts.translation:
[奥斯特里]
嗯？我感觉到你被要求帮那个人类一个忙。如果我是你，我会尽快完成那个任务。不知为何，那个人类的命运，以及矮人的命运，都交织在一起了...

scripts.text:
[Austri]
What is it?! I refuse to speak to human as rude and contemptible
as you! Now, get out of my sight!
scripts.translation:
[奥斯特里]
什么？！我拒绝与像你这样粗鲁且令人厌恶的人类对话！现在，给我滚出我的视线！

scripts.text:
[Austri]
What...?
I have nothing
to say to you.
scripts.translation:
[奥斯特里]
什么...？
我没什么
想对你说的。

scripts.text:
[Austri]
Hm...?
Why have you
come to me, human?
scripts.translation:
[奥斯特里]
嗯...？
你为何
来找我，人类？

scripts.text: Nothing.
scripts.translation: 没什么。

scripts.text: Hey, 'sup!
scripts.translation: 嘿，你好啊！

scripts.text:
[Austri]
...
scripts.translation:
[奥斯特里]
...

scripts.text:
[Austri]
What...?!
Do not greet the
Dwarves lightly,
mortal!
scripts.translation:
[奥斯特里]
什么？！
凡人，
不可如此轻慢地
向矮人致意！

scripts.text:
[Austri]
What has made
you come to me?
scripts.translation:
[奥斯特里]
是什么事
让你来找我？

scripts.text: Nothing.
scripts.translation: 没什么。

scripts.text: Excuse me, sir.
scripts.translation: 打扰了，先生。

scripts.text:
[Austri]
...
scripts.translation:
[奥斯特里]
...

scripts.text:
[Austri]
Ah, I see that the entire human race is not worthy of scorn. Unlike many of your kind, I see that you respect your elders.
scripts.translation:
[奥斯特里]
啊，看来并非所有人类都令人鄙夷。与你们中的许多人不同，我看到你懂得尊敬长者。

scripts.text:
[Austri]
So what did
want to ask
me about?
scripts.translation:
[奥斯特里]
那么你想
问我
什么？

scripts.text: About Mjolnir.
scripts.translation: 关于雷神之锤。

scripts.text:
[Austri]
Mjolnir...?
Thor's legendary weapon?
The hammer than can shake the earth and tear the sky asunder? Out of all of legendary weapons, Mjolnir is perhaps greatest.
scripts.translation:
[奥斯特里]
雷神之锤...？
索尔的传奇武器？
那把能撼动大地、撕裂天空的锤子？在所有传奇武器中，雷神之锤或许是最伟大的。

scripts.text:
[Austri]
As a matter of fact, it was forged by my ancestor. Mjolnir was the perfect weapon, except for one minor flaw.
scripts.translation:
[奥斯特里]
事实上，它是由我的祖先锻造的。雷神之锤是完美的武器，除了一个小瑕疵。

scripts.text:
[Austri]
The hilt of Mjolnir was forged shorter than intended. Are you still listening to me?
scripts.translation:
[奥斯特里]
雷神之锤的柄比预想的要短。你还在听吗？

scripts.text: Yes, sir!
scripts.translation: 是的，长官！

scripts.text: Huh?
scripts.translation: 咦？

scripts.text:
[Austri]
One day, Loki came to our village and showed off his treasures. He boasted that we couldn't possibly create something to surpass their quality.
scripts.translation:
[奥斯特里]
有一天，洛基来到我们的村庄，炫耀他的宝物。他吹嘘我们不可能创造出超越它们品质的东西。

scripts.text:
[Austri]
Frankly his treasures were
made by another Dwarf tribe, but we couldn't tolerate his insult. So my ancestors created three treasures of their own.
scripts.translation:
[奥斯特里]
坦白说，他的宝物是由另一个矮人部落制作的，但我们无法容忍他的侮辱。于是我的祖先们创造了三件属于自己的宝物。

scripts.text: Boooring!
scripts.translation: 好无聊！

scripts.text: Oh, wow.

scripts.text:
[Sudri]
Muhahahaha!
You're not strong enough to beat me! I want someone who can offer
me a challenge!
scripts.translation:
[苏德里]
穆哈哈哈！
你还不够强，打不过我！
我想要一个能给我带来挑战的对手！

scripts.text:
[Sudri]
Go out, train some and get stronger before you even think about coming back!
scripts.translation:
[苏德里]
出去练练，变强了再来找我吧！

scripts.text:
[Sudri]
You're stronger than me. I never thought I'd meet a human as strong as you.
scripts.translation:
[苏德里]
你比我强。
我没想到会遇到像你这么强的人类。

scripts.text:
[Sudri]
I'm impressed! Alright, I'll tell my friends good things about you. Hopefully, my brothers will give you the help you're looking for.
scripts.translation:
[苏德里]
我很佩服你！
好吧，我会跟我的兄弟们说你的好话。
希望他们能给你提供帮助。

scripts.text:
[Sudri]
Okay then,
be safe on
your travels!
scripts.translation:
[苏德里]
那么，
旅途平安！

scripts.text:
[Sudri]
So...
What brings
you here, human?
scripts.translation:
[苏德里]
那么...
人类，
你来这里做什么？

scripts.text: Nothing.
scripts.translation: 没什么。

scripts.text: Excuse me, sir.
scripts.translation: 打扰了，先生。

scripts.text:
[Sudri]
You have too much time on your hands. Why don't you log out and hang out with your buddies for a while?
scripts.translation:
[苏德里]
你闲得发慌了。
不如下线去跟你的朋友们聚聚？

scripts.text:
[Sudri]
Huh. You're different than other humans. But still, trusting you because you know how to speak respectfully isn't very wise.
scripts.translation:
[苏德里]
哼。你和其他人类不太一样。
不过，仅仅因为你懂礼貌就信任你，
这可不是什么明智之举。

scripts.text:
[Sudri]
If there's anything I love,
it's bare knuckle brawling,
old school style.
scripts.translation:
[苏德里]
如果要说我最热爱什么，
那就是赤手空拳的格斗，
最原始的那种风格。

scripts.text:
[Sudri]
Words can be deceptive,
but if you can beat me in
a fight, I think I might
just talk to you.
How about it?
scripts.translation:
[苏德里]
言语可能会欺骗人，
但如果你能在战斗中打败我，
我想我或许会愿意和你聊聊。
怎么样？

scripts.text: Yes, I accept your challenge.
scripts.translation: 是的，我接受你的挑战。

scripts.text: No, I'm scared!
scripts.translation: 不，我害怕了！

scripts.text:
[Sudri]
You didn't
even answer me!
Fine! Whatever!
scripts.translation:
[苏德里]
你甚至都没回答我！
算了！随你便！

scripts.text:
[Sudri]
Ah, I like you already, human! Now why don't you go do some warm ups, and we'll fight when you're ready.
scripts.translation:
[苏德里]
啊，我一开始就喜欢你，人类！
现在，你不妨去热热身，
等你准备好了我们再打。

scripts.text:
[Sudri]
Eh...?
Why are you being
such a coward?
Are you afraid of
this old and tiny Dwarf?
scripts.translation:
[苏德里]
呃...？
你为什么这么胆小？
你是怕我这个又老又小的矮人吗？

scripts.text:
[Sudri]
Come on, I'll even let you have the first hit. Just come to me when you're ready to fight!
scripts.translation:
[苏德里]
来吧，我甚至会让你先出手。
等你准备好战斗了就来找我！

scripts.text:
[Sudri]
Zzzz Zzzz...

[Sudri]
[Sudri]
Get out of here before I beat you to death! All you can gain over here is a few herbs, anyway!
scripts.translation:
[苏德里]
[苏德里]
在我把你打死之前赶紧滚！
反正你在这里只能采到几株草药而已！

scripts.text:
[Sudri]
That was a great fight!
Hahahahahahahahahaah!
I regret nothing.
I may have lost, but
I gave it my all!
scripts.translation:
[苏德里]
打得好！
哈哈哈哈哈哈！
我毫无遗憾。
虽然我输了，
但我已经全力以赴了！

scripts.text:
[Sudri]
What made you come to me?
scripts.translation:
[苏德里]
是什么让你来找我的？

scripts.text: Nothing.
scripts.translation: 没什么。

scripts.text: Excuse me, sir.
scripts.translation: 打扰了，先生。

scripts.text:
[Sudri]
You have too much
time on your hands.
Why don't you log out and go out with your friends instead?
scripts.translation:
[苏德里]
你闲得发慌了。
不如下线去跟你的朋友们聚聚？

scripts.text:
[Sudri]
Why should
I excuse you?
Do you want to
fight with me, huh?
scripts.translation:
[苏德里]
我为什么要原谅你？
你是想跟我打架，是吗？

scripts.text:
[Sudri]
Cool, let's fight!
scripts.translation:
[苏德里]
好，那就打吧！

scripts.text:
[Sudri]
Muhahahaha!
You're not strong enough to beat me! I want someone who can offer
me a challenge!
scripts.translation:
[苏德里]
穆哈哈哈！
你还不够强，打不过我！
我想要一个能给我带来挑战的对手！

scripts.text:
[Sudri]
Go out, train some and get stronger before you even think about coming back!
scripts.translation:
[苏德里]
出去练练，变强了再来找我吧！

scripts.text:
[Sudri]
You're stronger than me. I never thought I'd meet a human as strong as you.
scripts.translation:
[苏德里]
你比我强。
我没想到会遇到像你这么强的人类。

scripts.text:
[Sudri]
I'm impressed! Alright, I'll tell my friends good things about you. Hopefully, my brothers will give you the help you're looking for.
scripts.translation:
[苏德里]
我很佩服你！
好吧，我会跟我的兄弟们说你的好话。
希望他们能给你提供帮助。

scripts.text:
[Sudri]
Okay then,
be safe on
your travels!
scripts.translation:
[苏德里]
那么，
旅途平安！

scripts.text:
[Sudri]
What made you come to me?
scripts.translation:
[苏德里]
是什么让你来找我的？

scripts.text: Nothing.
scripts.translation: 没什么。

scripts.text: Excuse me, sir.
scripts.translation: 打扰了，先生。

scripts.text:
[Sudri]
You have too much
time on your hands.
Why don't you log out and go out with your friends instead?
scripts.translation:
[苏德里]
你闲得发慌了。
不如下线去跟你的朋友们聚聚？

scripts.text:
[Sudri]
Huh. You're different than other humans. But still, trusting you because you know how to speak respectfully isn't very wise.
scripts.translation:
[苏德里]
哼。你和其他人类不太一样。
不过，仅仅因为你懂礼貌就信任你，
这可不是什么明智之举。

scripts.text:
[Sudri]
If there's anything I love,
it's bare knuckle brawling,
old school style.
scripts.translation:
[苏德里]
如果要说我最热爱什么，
那就是赤手空拳的格斗，
最原始的那种风格。

scripts.text:
[Sudri]
Words can be deceptive,
but if you can beat me in
a fight, I think I might
just talk to you.
How about it?
scripts.translation:
[苏德里]
言语可能会欺骗人，
但如果你能在战斗中打败我，
我想我或许会愿意和你聊聊。
怎么样？

scripts.text: Yes, I accept your challenge.
scripts.translation: 是的，我接受你的挑战。

scripts.text: No, I'm scared!
scripts.translation: 不，我害怕了！

scripts.text:
[Sudri]
You didn't
even answer me!
Fine! Whatever!
scripts.translation:
[苏德里]
你甚至都没回答我！
算了！随你便！

scripts.text:
[Sudri]
Ah, I like you already, human! Now why don't you go do some warm ups, and we'll fight when you're ready.
scripts.translation:
[苏德里]
啊，我一开始就喜欢你，人类！
现在，你不妨去热热身，
等你准备好了我们再打。

scripts.text:
[Sudri]
Eh...?
Why are you being
such a coward?
Are you afraid of
this old and tiny Dwarf?
scripts.translation:
[苏德里]
呃...？
你为什么这么胆小？
你是怕我这个又老又小的矮人吗？

scripts.text:
[Sudri]
Come on, I'll even let you have the first hit. Just come to me when you're ready to fight!
scripts.translation:
[苏德里]
来吧，我甚至会让你先出手。
等你准备好战斗了就来找我！

scripts.text:
[Sudri]
Zzzz Zzzz...

[Sudri]
In a one on one fight, you put everything on the line to show your might to your opponent.
scripts.translation:
[苏德里]
在单挑中，你会押上所有筹码，
向对手展示你的力量。

scripts.text:
[Sudri]
Have you ever felt the same way I do, human? Win or lose, just giving your all is the most satisfying accomplishment.
scripts.translation:
[苏德里]
人类，你是否有过和我一样的感受？
无论胜负，全力以赴本身就是最满足的成就。

scripts.text:
[Sudri]
Zzzz Zzzz...

[Vestri]
If you want something, you should earn it through your own efforts.
scripts.translation:
[韦斯特里]
如果你想要什么，就应该靠自己的努力去争取。

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
No matter what other people say, if you're confident and your will is unwavering, you'll always be satisfied with the results.
scripts.translation:
[韦斯特里]
不管别人怎么说，只要你自信且意志坚定，
你总会对自己的结果感到满意。

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
What do you think?
Kids these days...
scripts.translation:
[韦斯特里]
你觉得呢？
现在的年轻人啊...

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
I don't feel
like doing anything
today. Anything at all...
scripts.translation:
[韦斯特里]
我今天什么都不想做。
什么都...不想做...

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
Someone must have forged something really monstrous, otherwise I wouldn't be feeling so worthless!
scripts.translation:
[韦斯特里]
一定是有人锻造出了什么怪物级的东西，
不然我怎么会觉得自己这么没用！

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
Yeah, I think I need a break! Don't you think I need a break, human?
scripts.translation:
[韦斯特里]
是啊，我觉得我需要休息一下！
你不觉得我也该休息一下吗，人类？

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
There's nothing like taking a relaxing break after putting your heart into your work.
scripts.translation:
[韦斯特里]
全心投入工作后，没有什么比放松休息更惬意的了。

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
What do you think,
human? Isn't that one
of life's simple pleasures?
scripts.translation:
[韦斯特里]
你觉得呢，人类？
这不是生活中简单的乐趣之一吗？

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
If you want something, you should earn it through your own efforts.
scripts.translation:
[韦斯特里]
如果你想要什么，就应该靠自己的努力去争取。

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
No matter what other people say, if you're confident and your will is unwavering, you'll always be satisfied with the results.
scripts.translation:
[韦斯特里]
不管别人怎么说，只要你自信且意志坚定，
你总会对自己的结果感到满意。

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
What do you think?
Kids these days...
scripts.translation:
[韦斯特里]
你觉得呢？
现在的年轻人啊...

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
I really hope I meet a decent human being next time. So far, I haven't met one useful human.
scripts.translation:
[韦斯特里]
真希望下次能遇到个靠谱的人类。
到目前为止，我还没遇到过有用的人类。

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
Perfect preparation does not always result in success. There's a point when you've got to just go out and do it.
scripts.translation:
[韦斯特里]
完美的准备并不总能带来成功。
到了某个时刻，你就必须放手一搏。

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
I don't know how
big your goals are,
but put your heart into
whatever it is that you
plan to accomplish in life.
scripts.translation:
[韦斯特里]
我不知道你的目标有多大，
但请全心投入你计划在生活中实现的任何事。

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
What do you want?
scripts.translation:
[韦斯特里]
你想要什么？

scripts.text: Nothing.
scripts.translation: 没什么。

scripts.text: Excuse me.
scripts.translation: 打扰一下

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
If you want something, you should earn it through your own efforts.
scripts.translation:
[韦斯特里]
如果你想要什么，就应该靠自己的努力去争取。

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
No matter what other people say, if you're confident and your will is unwavering, you'll always be satisfied with the results.
scripts.translation:
[韦斯特里]
不管别人怎么说，只要你自信且意志坚定，
你总会对自己的结果感到满意。

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
You didn't answer the question! Now, you've probably got the wrong Dwarf here...
scripts.translation:
[韦斯特里]
你没有回答问题！
现在，你大概找错矮人了吧...

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
Get out of here, and go to your human Blacksmiths if you want equipment upgrades!
scripts.translation:
[韦斯特里]
滚出去，如果你想升级装备，去找你们人类的铁匠！

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
Great...!
Which one should I upgrade first, huh? My heart is pounding with anticipation...
scripts.translation:
[韦斯特里]
太好了！
我该先升级哪一个呢？
我的心因期待而怦怦直跳...

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
What...?!
This isn't upgradable!
What the hell do you want
me to do with this?
scripts.translation:
[韦斯特里]
什么...？！
这东西不能升级！
你到底想让我拿它怎么办？

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
Oh, this is excellent! This piece here has been perfectly refined! But this isn't what I want. I can't do any work on this at all.
scripts.translation:
[韦斯特里]
哦，这很棒！这件作品已经完美精炼了！
但这不是我想要的。我完全无法对它进行任何加工。

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
This item isn't even a challenge to upgrade. You can get humans to do this kind of beginner's stuff. Get them to refine it first.
scripts.translation:
[韦斯特里]
这件物品甚至算不上升级的挑战。
这种新手活儿你可以让人类去做。让他们先精炼一下。

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
Come on...
Bring me something
that presents an
element of risk!
scripts.translation:
[韦斯特里]
拜托...
给我拿点有风险的东西来！

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
Armor?!
Didn't I tell
you that I only work
on Level 4 weapons?
scripts.translation:
[韦斯特里]
防具？！
我不是说过我只加工4级以上的武器吗？

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
You can have a human
Blacksmith work on that kind of stuff! Now, a Dwarf like me needs something that's more of a challenge!
scripts.translation:
[韦斯特里]
这种活儿你去找人类铁匠做吧！像我这样的矮人，需要的是更有挑战性的工作！

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
Hey...
Don't insult me by expecting me to work on anything less than a Level 4 weapon.
scripts.translation:
[韦斯特里]
喂...
别拿4级以下的武器来侮辱我。

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
Bring me a Level 4 weapon for me to work on next time, got it?
scripts.translation:
[韦斯特里]
下次记得带4级以上的武器来，听到了吗？

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
Okay, let me give you the mandatory warning. If your weapon happens to be destroyed by chance during the upgrade, you'll never see the weapon again.
scripts.translation:
[韦斯特里]
好，让我给你个必要的警告。如果升级过程中武器不幸被毁，你就再也见不到它了。

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
That also means that if the weapon is destroyed, any ^FF0000Cards^000000 inserted into the weapon will also be gone.
scripts.translation:
[韦斯特里]
也就是说，如果武器被毁，插在里面的^FF0000卡片^000000也会一起消失。

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
If you understand,
then let's get on with it!
scripts.translation:
[韦斯特里]
如果你明白了，那就开始吧！

scripts.text: Sure, let's do it!
scripts.translation: 好的，开始吧！

scripts.text: N-no, I changed my mind!
scripts.translation: 不...不，我改变主意了！

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
Bah...!
How do you survive
in this world with that
kind of cowardice?!
scripts.translation:
[韦斯特里]
哼...！
像你这种胆小鬼，是怎么在这个世界活下来的？！

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
Oh, forget it.
I know you're just being careful. Damn, I was just so eager to get
to work!
scripts.translation:
[韦斯特里]
算了。
我知道你只是比较谨慎。该死，我还正急着开工呢！

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
Huh...
You forgot to
bring an Oridecon.
Hurry up and get one.
scripts.translation:
[韦斯特里]
咦...
你忘了带神之金属。

scripts.translation:

成功了！

scripts.text:

[Vestri]

Dear God, no!
scripts.translation:

天哪，不！

Bad things happen
sometimes. Let's just
think of it as both us
of us having a bad day.
Yeah, no regrets!

坏事总会发生。就当是我们俩今天运气不好吧。
没错，不留遗憾！

if you ever visit my brothers, please give them my regards.

如果你想要什么，就应该靠自己的努力去争取。

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
No matter what other people say, if you're confident and your will is unwavering, you'll always be satisfied with the results.
scripts.translation:
[韦斯特里]

你总会对自己的结果感到满意。

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
Huh...
I don't know how I can be much help to an adventurer like you. Aside from being a Blacksmith...
scripts.translation:
[韦斯特里]
咦...
除了当铁匠之外，我不知道还能怎么帮到你这样的冒险者。

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
There's nothing I enjoy more than upgrading high level weapons that are on the verge of breaking.
scripts.translation:
[韦斯特里]
没有什么比升级那些濒临破碎的高等级武器更让我享受的了。

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
Don't you like the idea of challenging the limit? To me, upgrading feels like climbing unconquered mountains!
scripts.translation:
[韦斯特里]
你不觉得挑战极限很刺激吗？对我来说，强化武器就像攀登未征服的山峰一样！

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
Alright. Perhaps I'm meant to help you out, so I'll upgrade a weapon for you. All you need to do is bring me the weapon and material.
scripts.translation:
[韦斯特里]
好吧。也许我命中注定要帮你的忙，那我就帮你强化一把武器吧。你只需要把武器和材料带给我就行。

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
Here's the condition: You've got to bring me a Level 4 Weapon that's been upgraded to the point where it might break. Oh, and bring an Oridecon!
scripts.translation:
[韦斯特里]
条件是：你得带一把已经强化到随时可能碎裂的4级武器来。哦，还要带一块神之金属！

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
Zzzz Zzzz Zzzz...

[Vestri]
I really hope I meet a decent human being next time. So far, I haven't met one useful human.
scripts.translation:
[韦斯特里]
真希望下次能遇到个靠谱的人类。
到目前为止，我还没遇到过有用的人类。

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
Perfect preparation does not always result in success. There's a point when you've got to just go out and do it.
scripts.translation:
[韦斯特里]
完美的准备并不总能带来成功。
到了某个时刻，你就必须放手一搏。

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
I don't know how
big your goals are,
but put your heart into
whatever it is that you
plan to accomplish in life.
scripts.translation:
[韦斯特里]
我不知道你的目标有多大，
但请全心投入你计划在生活中实现的任何事。

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
You didn't answer the question! Now, you've probably got the wrong Dwarf here...
scripts.translation:
[韦斯特里]
你没有回答问题！
现在，你大概找错矮人了吧...

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
Get out of here, and go to your human Blacksmiths if you want equipment upgrades!
scripts.translation:
[韦斯特里]
滚出去，如果你想升级装备，去找你们人类的铁匠！

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
Great...!
Which one should I upgrade first, huh? My heart is pounding with anticipation...
scripts.translation:
[韦斯特里]
太好了！
我该先升级哪一个呢？
我的心因期待而怦怦直跳...

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
What...?!
This isn't upgradable!
What the hell do you want
me to do with this?
scripts.translation:
[韦斯特里]
什么...？！
这东西不能升级！
你到底想让我拿它怎么办？

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
Oh, this is excellent! This piece here has been perfectly refined! But this isn't what I want. I can't do any work on this at all.
scripts.translation:
[韦斯特里]
哦，这很棒！这件作品已经完美精炼了！
但这不是我想要的。我完全无法对它进行任何加工。

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
This item isn't even a challenge to upgrade. You can get humans to do this kind of beginner's stuff. Get them to refine it first.
scripts.translation:
[韦斯特里]
这件物品甚至算不上升级的挑战。
这种新手活儿你可以让人类去做。让他们先精炼一下。

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
Come on...
Bring me something
that presents an
element of risk!
scripts.translation:
[韦斯特里]
拜托...
给我拿点有风险的东西来！

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
Armor?!
Didn't I tell
you that I only work
on Level 4 weapons?
scripts.translation:
[韦斯特里]
防具？！
我不是说过我只加工4级以上的武器吗？

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
Hey...
Don't insult me by expecting me to work on anything less than a Level 4 weapon.
scripts.translation:
[韦斯特里]
喂...
别拿4级以下的武器来侮辱我。

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
Bring me a Level 4 weapon for me to work on next time, got it?
scripts.translation:
[韦斯特里]
下次记得带4级以上的武器来，听到了吗？

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
Okay, let me give you the mandatory warning. If your weapon happens to be destroyed by chance during the upgrade, you'll never see the weapon again.
scripts.translation:
[韦斯特里]
好，让我给你个必要的警告。如果升级过程中武器不幸被毁，你就再也见不到它了。

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
That also means that if the weapon is destroyed, any ^FF0000Cards^000000 inserted into the weapon will also be gone.
scripts.translation:
[韦斯特里]
也就是说，如果武器被毁，插在里面的^FF0000卡片^000000也会一起消失。

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
If you understand,
then let's get on with it!
scripts.translation:
[韦斯特里]
如果你明白了，那就开始吧！

scripts.text: Sure, let's do it!
scripts.translation: 好的，开始吧！

scripts.text: ...no, I am out.
scripts.translation: ...不，我拒绝。

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
Bah...!
How do you survive
in this world with that
kind of cowardice?!
scripts.translation:
[韦斯特里]
哼...！
像你这种胆小鬼，是怎么在这个世界活下来的？！

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
Oh, forget it.
I know you're just being careful. Damn, I was just so eager to get
to work!
scripts.translation:
[韦斯特里]
算了。
我知道你只是比较谨慎。该死，我还正急着开工呢！

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
Huh...
You forgot to
bring an Oridecon.
Hurry up and get one.
scripts.translation:

你忘了带神之金属。

[Vestri]
It's always a pleasure to engage myself in hard work, especially smithing.
scripts.translation:
[韦斯特里]
从事艰苦的工作总是令人愉悦的，尤其是打铁。

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
Upgrading is always enjoyable!
I have no regrets when failure, and I'm always pleased when I'm successful. I'll upgrade everyday to make the best of my life~
scripts.translation:
[韦斯特里]
强化总是充满乐趣！
失败时我不后悔，成功时我总是很高兴。我会每天强化，以此度过我精彩的一生~

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
Zzzz Zzzz Zzzz...

[Nordri]
What...?
I don't have any
Eluniums or Oridecons!
scripts.translation:
[诺德里]
什...么？
我这里没有铝，也没有神之金属！

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
Vestri took them all. ^333333*Sigh*^000000 Those were my treasures, you know...
scripts.translation:
[诺德里]
都被韦斯特里拿走了。^333333*叹气*^000000 那可是我的宝贝啊...

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
What's happening?
I sense change in the winds, but what that change may be, I cannot tell.
scripts.translation:
[诺德里]
发生什么事了？
我感觉到风中有变化，但具体是什么变化，我还说不清。

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
Should I go into the cave to figure it out? Huh. This is most peculiar.
scripts.translation:
[诺德里]
我该去洞穴里弄清楚吗？嗯。这真是奇怪。

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
Bwahahah!
Even the gods know that we Dwarves are the most talented of artisans! Maybe it doesn't seem that way now, but someday we shall return.
scripts.translation:
[诺德里]
哇哈哈！
连众神都知道，我们矮人是技艺最精湛的工匠！也许现在看起来不像，但总有一天我们会回来的。

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
What...?
I don't have any
Eluniums or Oridecons!
scripts.translation:
[诺德里]
什...么？
我这里没有铝，也没有神之金属！

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
Vestri took them all.
Don't you understand?
scripts.translation:
[诺德里]
都被韦斯特里拿走了。
你不明白吗？

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
Eh heh heh~
It's nice being in the Mjolnir Forest. To be surrounded by the quiet, peaceful air and not having to worry about anything...
scripts.translation:
[诺德里]
嘿嘿嘿~
在雷神之锤森林待着真舒服。被宁静祥和的空气包围，什么都不用担心...

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
Shouldn't you be on your way by now? Eh, it's none of my business.
scripts.translation:
[诺德里]
你不该早就出发了吗？嗯，这也不是我的事。

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
If you have the Zeny to spare, why don't you buy some snacks for your travels? Perhaps some delicious Bananas, or even some Pumpkins...
scripts.translation:
[诺德里]
如果你有多余的Zeny，为什么不买点路上的零食呢？也许是一些美味的香蕉，甚至是南瓜...

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
What business
do you have with
me, human?
scripts.translation:
[诺德里]
你找
我有什么事，
人类？

scripts.text: Nothing.
scripts.translation: 没什么。

scripts.text: Excuse me.
scripts.translation: 打扰一下

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
Huh.
If that's the case,
then leave me alone.
scripts.translation:
[诺德里]
哼。
如果是那样的话，
就别来烦我。

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
Huh.
That's fine. Still...
I'm surprised to see
such a polite human.
scripts.translation:
[诺德里]
哼。
那好吧。不过...
见到你这么有礼貌的人类，
我有点惊讶。

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
Ah, you've brought
me a Red Potion, just
like I asked. In return,
I will tell you an old story.
I'm sure you'll like it.
scripts.translation:
[诺德里]
啊，你按我说的带了红色药水来。
作为回报，我给你讲个古老的故事。
我相信你会喜欢的。

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
This is a legend about one
of Thor's journeys into Utgard,
land of the giants.
scripts.translation:
[诺德里]
这是关于托尔前往巨人国度乌特加德的一段传说。

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
There, he made a wager with their king in which he would challenge
the giants of their land in tests of skill and strength.
scripts.translation:
[诺德里]
在那里，他与巨人的国王打赌，要挑战那里的巨人们，进行技艺和力量的较量。

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
The first was an eating contest. Thor ate all of the meat on his table, but his opponent, Utgardaloki, ate his meat, the bones and even the plates.
scripts.translation:
[诺德里]
第一项是吃食比赛。托尔吃光了桌上的所有肉，但他的对手乌特加洛基不仅吃了肉，连骨头和盘子都吃了。

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
In truth, Thor was tricked, and the opponent that defeated him was not
actually a giant. Illusion was used to disguise Thor's opponent, but I forget was it was. Do you know?
scripts.translation:
[诺德里]
实际上，托尔被骗了，击败他的对手其实并不是巨人。对手使用了<黑暗搜集者>幻觉来伪装自己，但我忘了那是什么了。你知道吗？

scripts.text: Greed
scripts.translation: 贪婪

scripts.text: Sea
scripts.translation: 大海

scripts.text: Blaze
scripts.translation: 烈焰

scripts.text: Hog
scripts.translation: 野猪

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
Yes, only a Blaze could have effortlessly consumed meat, bones and plates by burning. Of course!
I remember now!
scripts.translation:
[诺德里]
没错，只有烈焰才能毫不费力地通过燃烧来吞噬肉、骨头和盘子。当然！
我想起来了！

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
The next contest was a race. In that match, Thor's servant, Tialfi competed with the king's servant, Hugi. However, no matter how many matches they had, Hugi would win every time.
scripts.translation:
[诺德里]
第二项比赛是赛跑。在那场比赛中，托尔的仆人提亚尔菲与国王的仆人胡基进行了较量。然而，无论比了多少次，胡基总是获胜。

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
Once again, illusion magic was
used to disguise the competitor. Do you know what Tialfi was really racing against?
scripts.translation:
[诺德里]
再次地，对手使用了<黑暗搜集者>幻觉来伪装自己。你知道提亚尔菲实际上在和谁赛跑吗？

scripts.text: Language
scripts.translation: 语言

scripts.text: Thoughts
scripts.translation: 思想

scripts.text: Turtle
scripts.translation: 乌龟

scripts.text: Wolf
scripts.translation: 狼

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
Yes, right! Tialfi was racing 'thoughts!' Nothing can move faster than the speed of thought, so it's no wonder Tialfi would always lose.
scripts.translation:
[诺德里]
没错，对了！提亚尔菲是在和“思想”赛跑！没有什么能比思想的速度更快，所以提亚尔菲总是输也就不足为奇了。

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
For the final contest, Thor would challenge an old woman in a wrestling match. At first, Thor thought his victory was assured, but he learned that he could not defeat the old crone.
scripts.translation:
[诺德里]
最后一项比赛，托尔要与一位老妇人进行摔跤。起初，托尔以为胜券在握，但他发现根本无法击败这位老妪。

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
Once again, Thor was the victim
of illusion magic. He didn't realize he wasn't actually wrestling with an old woman. Do you know what his opponent really was?
scripts.translation:
[诺德里]
再次地，托尔成了<黑暗搜集者>幻觉的受害者。他并没有意识到自己实际上并不是在和一位老妇人摔跤。你知道他的对手真正是什么吗？

scripts.text: Curse
scripts.translation: 诅咒

scripts.text: Earth
scripts.translation: 地

scripts.text: Heart
scripts.translation: 心

scripts.text: Old Age
scripts.translation: 衰老

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
Yes, Thor was wrestling with 'Old Age!' No matter how strong anybody is, you can't fight against aging.
scripts.translation:
[诺德里]
没错，托尔是在和“衰老”摔跤！无论一个人多么强壮，都无法战胜衰老。

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
After Thor lost every match,
the king told him the truth about the contests. Thor grew furious, but it was too late. The king and the giants all vanished by then.
scripts.translation:
[诺德里]
托尔输掉了所有比赛后，
国王告诉他了比赛的真相。托尔勃然大怒，但为时已晚。国王和巨人们全都消失了。

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
There are two lessons
to be learned from this tale. First, don't believe everything you see. Second, never be overconfident of your own power.
scripts.translation:
[诺德里]
这个故事有两个教训。
第一，不要相信你所看到的一切。第二，永远不要对自己的力量过于自信。

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
There will always be someone or something more powerful than you. It is important to always do your best and have an attitude of humility.
scripts.translation:
[诺德里]
总会有比你更强大的人或事物存在。保持谦逊的态度，并始终尽力而为，这一点很重要。

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
Try to live as good a life as you can. Remember that you can't have everything that you want. Obssession and irrationality go hand in hand.
scripts.translation:
[诺德里]
尽量过好的生活。记住，你不可能得到你想要的一切。执念和非理性总是相伴而生。

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
Thank you for listening to my long story. If you meet someone with a dangerous obsession, please tell this story of Thor and the illusions of the giant king.
scripts.translation:
[诺德里]
谢谢你听我讲这么长的故事。如果你遇到有人陷入危险的执念，请告诉他托尔和巨人国王幻觉的故事。

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
Huh...?
I don't think that's right. Let me think, maybe I can remember it. Hopefully, it'll come to me sooner or later...
scripts.translation:
[诺德里]
嗯...？
我觉得不对。让我想想，也许我能想起来。希望我迟早能想起来...

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
Shall we talk more of this once again after enjoying another Red Potion? Hahahahaha~
scripts.translation:
[诺德里]
我们再喝一杯红色药水，然后继续聊这个话题吧？哈哈哈哈哈~

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
Oooh...
I'm sooo thirsty!
scripts.translation:
[诺德里]
哦哦...
我渴死了！

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
Hm, didn't I ask you to bring a Red Potion? There's no way I can tell any stories with such a dry throat~
scripts.translation:
[诺德里]
嗯，我不是让你带红色药水来吗？嗓子这么干，我没法讲故事啊~

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
What business
do you have with
me, human?
scripts.translation:
[诺德里]
你找
我有什么事，
人类？

scripts.text: Nothing.
scripts.translation: 没什么。

scripts.text: Excuse me.
scripts.translation: 打扰一下

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
Huh.
If that's the case,
then leave me alone.
scripts.translation:
[诺德里]
哼。
如果是那样的话，
就别来烦我。

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
Odd. Recently, too many humans have been interested in meeting with me and my brothers. Still, I cannot say their visits have been unpleasant.
scripts.translation:
[诺德里]
奇怪。最近有太多人类想见我和我的兄弟们了。不过，我也不能说他们的来访不愉快。

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
I'm a little thirsty. Would you bring me a Red Potion. If you do that for me, I will tell you an important story. Heh heh heh~
scripts.translation:
[诺德里]
我有点渴。你能给我带一瓶红色药水吗？如果你帮我这个忙，我会告诉你一个重要的故事。嘿嘿嘿~

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
Zzzz Zzzz...
scripts.translation:
[诺德里]
呼噜呼噜...

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
Eh heh heh~
It's nice being in the Mjolnir Forest. To be surrounded by the quiet, peaceful air and not having to worry about anything...
scripts.translation:
[诺德里]
嘿嘿嘿~
在雷神之锤森林待着真舒服。被宁静祥和的空气包围，什么都不用担心...

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
Shouldn't you be on your way by now? Eh, it's none of my business.
scripts.translation:
[诺德里]
你不该早就出发了吗？嗯，这也不是我的事。

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
If you have the Zeny to spare, why don't you buy some snacks for your travels? Perhaps some delicious Bananas, or even some Pumpkins...
scripts.translation:
[诺德里]
如果你有多余的Zeny，为什么不买点路上的零食呢？也许是一些美味的香蕉，甚至是南瓜...

What business
do you have with
me, human?
scripts.translation:
[诺德里]
你找
我有什么事，
人类？

scripts.text: Nothing.
scripts.translation: 没什么。

scripts.translation: 打扰一下

then leave me alone.
scripts.translation:

哼。
如果是那样的话，
就别来烦我。

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
Huh.
That's fine. Still...
I'm surprised to see
such a polite human.
scripts.translation:
[诺德里]
哼。
那好吧。不过...
见到你这么有礼貌的人类，
我有点惊讶。

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
Ah, you've brought
me a Red Potion...?
In return, I will
tell you an old story.
I'm sure you'll like it.
scripts.translation:
[诺德里]
啊，你带了
红色药水来...？
作为回报，我会
给你讲一个古老的故事。
我相信你会喜欢的。

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
There is a story of a Dwarf named Alvis who contained more knowledge than a library and was braver than Siegfried the warrior.
scripts.translation:
[诺德里]
有一个名叫阿尔维斯的矮人的故事，他比图书馆还博学，比战士齐格飞还勇敢。

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
Unfortunately...
He was too ambitious.
He fell in love with Thrud, Thor's first daughter, at first sight.
scripts.translation:
[诺德里]
不幸的是...
他太有野心了。
他一见托尔的大女儿特鲁德就爱上了她。

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
He asked Thor for permission to marry Thrud, but as was expected, Thor refused. Alvis should have given up there, but he didn't.
scripts.translation:
[诺德里]
他向托尔请求娶特鲁德，但不出所料，托尔拒绝了。阿尔维斯本该就此放弃，但他没有。

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
So Thor decided to test his knowledge by asking him some questions. The first question was, 'What is the name of the ground in human terms?' Do you know the answer?
scripts.translation:
[诺德里]
于是托尔决定通过提问来测试他的知识。第一个问题是：“用人类的语言来说，大地的名字是什么？”你知道答案吗？

scripts.text: Ymir's body
scripts.translation: 尤弥尔的身体

scripts.text: Earth
scripts.translation: 地

scripts.text: Lane
scripts.translation: 车道

scripts.text: Universe
scripts.translation: 宇宙

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
Yes, that's right, 'Earth.' Alvis was able to also answer Thor's question correctly.
scripts.translation:
[诺德里]
没错，就是“地”。阿尔维斯也正确回答了托尔的问题。

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
Thor then gave Alvis another question. What is the giant's term for the round shell that covers the earth?
scripts.translation:
[诺德里]
接着，托尔又问了他一个问题。在巨人的语言中，覆盖大地的圆形外壳叫什么？

scripts.text: Ymir's Head
scripts.translation: 尤弥尔的头

scripts.text: Sky
scripts.translation: 天空

scripts.text: Cloud Factory
scripts.translation: 云工厂

scripts.text: High House
scripts.translation: 高屋

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
That's it, 'High House.' Since the giants are so huge, it might have looked that way to them.
scripts.translation:
[诺德里]
没错，是“高屋”。因为巨人非常巨大，所以在他们看来可能就是这样。

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
So Thor gave him another question. What is the term for the ball that rises in the sky at night, as used by the gods?
scripts.translation:
[诺德里]
于是托尔又问了他一个问题。在众神的语言中，夜晚升上天空的球体叫什么？

scripts.text: Circling Wheel
scripts.translation: 旋转之轮

scripts.text: Moon
scripts.translation: 月亮

scripts.text: False Sun
scripts.translation: 假太阳

scripts.text: Fast Stranger
scripts.translation: 快速的外人

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
Yes! Gods refer to the
moon as the 'false sun.'
Although Alvis answered all of Thor's questions, he didn't notice the sun was rising.
scripts.translation:
[诺德里]
没错！众神称月亮为“假太阳”。
虽然阿尔维斯回答了托尔的所有问题，但他没有注意到太阳正在升起。

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
Yes...
Thor prolonged his test so that Alvis would be turned to stone
once the sun rose.
scripts.translation:
[诺德里]
是的...
托尔故意拖延测试，以便在太阳升起时将阿尔维斯变成石头。

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
There are two
things we can learn
from this story. First, do not covet something to the point of challenging fate or the gods.
scripts.translation:
[诺德里]
从这个故事中我们可以学到两件事。第一，不要贪得无厌，甚至去挑战命运或众神。

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
Secondly, do not have too much pride in yourself. No matter how much ability or talent you may have, you cannot get everything
you want.
scripts.translation:
[诺德里]
第二，不要过于自负。无论你的能力或天赋有多高，你都无法得到你想要的一切。

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
It's most
important to live a
good and virtuous life. It's great to achieve your desires, but be aware that some desires are not meant to be fulfilled.
scripts.translation:
[诺德里]
最重要的是过一种善良而正直的生活。实现愿望固然很好，但要知道有些愿望是不该被满足的。

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
Thank you for listening to my long story. If you meet anyone afflicted with an insatiable desire, please tell him this story of Thor and Alvis, a brave yet very defiant Dwarf.
scripts.translation:
[诺德里]
谢谢你听我讲这么长的故事。如果你遇到任何被无尽欲望困扰的人，请告诉他托尔和阿尔维斯的故事，这位勇敢但非常傲慢的矮人。

Zzzz Zzzz Zzzz...

[Nordri]
I am Nordri,
Dwarven Blacksmith.
scripts.translation:
[诺德里]
我是诺德里，矮人铁匠。

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
I am in charge of this Northern part of Mount Mjolnir. If you wish to pass, you must first secure my approval!
scripts.translation:
[诺德里]
我负责雷神之锤北部的守卫工作。如果你想通过，必须先得到我的批准！

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
Ho ho ho...
Calm down, it
was only a joke.
Hahahahaha!
scripts.translation:
[诺德里]
呵呵呵...
冷静点，
我只是开个玩笑。
哈哈哈哈！
